items.exampleEn: Please clean up your room before your friends arrive.
items.exampleZh: 你的朋友來之前，請把房間打掃乾淨。

items.exampleEn: Excuse me, may I come in?
items.exampleZh: 不好意思，我可以進來嗎？

items.exampleEn: Dad will come back at seven tonight.
I finally found out the name of that song.
items.exampleZh: 我終於查到那首歌的歌名了。

items.exampleEn: Get up! You will be late for school.
We got on the train at the last minute.
items.exampleZh: 我們在最後一刻上了火車。

items.exampleEn: This is my stop. I need to get off.

items.sentenceEn: Don't forget your umbrella when you get off the train.
items.sentenceZh: 下火車的時候別忘了你的雨傘。

items.audioEn: I called the shop to find out when it opens.
items.audioZh: 我打電話給那家店，問它幾點開門。
items.questionZh: 說話的人為什麼打電話給那家店？
options: To ask about a lost bag

items.sentenceEn: Come back soon. We will miss you.
items.sentenceZh: 早點回來，我們會想你的。

items.sentenceEn: The children helped clean the park up on Saturday.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們星期六幫忙把公園打掃乾淨。

items.stemEn: It's Sunday morning, and I'm still in bed. I don't want to ____ yet.
items.stemZh: 現在是星期天早上，我還在床上，我還不想起床。

items.stemEn: Can you ____ what time the movie starts?
items.stemZh: 你可以查一下電影幾點開始嗎？

items.passageEn: Every Saturday, Amy gets up at seven and rides the bus to her grandma's house. She gets on near the park and gets off at the end of the line. When she comes in, Grandma always cooks eggs and rice for her. After eating, they clean up together. Last week, Amy found out that her grandma can speak Japanese! In the evening, Amy leaves and promises to come back next Saturday.
items.passageZh: 每個星期六，Amy 七點起床，搭公車去奶奶家。她在公園附近上車，在終點站下車。她一進門，奶奶總是煮蛋和飯給她吃。吃完以後，她們一起收拾乾淨。上星期，Amy 發現奶奶會說日文！傍晚，Amy 離開時答應下星期六再回來。

questions.questionZh: Amy 上星期發現了什麼？

items.promptZh: 我弟弟每天早上七點起床。
referenceEn: My brother gets up at seven every morning.
My younger brother gets up at seven every morning.
Every morning, my brother gets up at seven.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 gets up 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 wakes up、gets out of bed 等）也算對
每天的習慣用現在簡單式（例如 gets up、always gets up、wakes up 等）
「弟弟」可寫，例如 brother、younger brother、little brother 等

referenceEn: It's cold outside. Please come in.
Please come in. It's cold outside.
It is very cold outside, so please come in.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 come in 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 come inside、come into the house 等）也算對
「外面很冷」可寫，例如 It's cold outside、It is very cold outside 等
兩句的先後順序不限，也可以用 so 連接
